task: Keep current-period spend visible for budgets removed from a project by selecting spend rows per budget category in the projects spending-widget router and rendering unassigned categories with spend as 'not assigned' in the frontend (EPMCDME-15048).

key_reasoning.reason: ProjectSpendTrackingRepository (new per-category latest-row lookup), projects router helpers and SpendingWidgetRow response model (both attach paths rewritten), plus frontend ProjectSpendingWidgetRow type, ProjectBudgetCard EmptyCard and ProjectBudgetsSection across two repos (codemie, codemie-ui-next).

About 5 source files (repository, router, TS type, card, section) and 5-6 test files (repository SQL tests, two router test modules with 5 mock sites, two frontend test files) across 3+ directories in two repos; no new modules.

Query mirrors get_latest_before_by_budget_category_ids and selection replaces _drop_unassigned_budget_rows, but period-boundary logic on frozen budget_reset_at of soft-deleted budgets, naive-UTC coercion and remove/re-add double-count scenarios are non-trivial; not security-sensitive and additive to the API. Calibration: bundled M example epmcdme-10203 (total 15) agrees with the M band.
